title: wa.message.sent
description: PAYLOAD of the `wa.message.sent` envelope. Topic: engagement.wa.message.sent. Emitted via the Origin Connector (§3.4) when the live whatsapp.py sends a message (template or free-form). The whatsapp service is an ADAPTER over the live stack (§16.1). Carries the template + category for the WA cost meter (per-template-message billing since Jan2026 ⚠VERIFY-LIVE; India marketing ~Rs0.86, utility/auth ~Rs0.115 pre-BSP+GST §23). Honors the 24h / free-72h-CTWA windows + per-user marketing caps (§16.1).

to.description: Recipient E.164 / wa_id — the correlation key (§8.3).

category.description: WABA pricing category — drives the cost meter (§16.1).

journey_step.description: Which follow-up journey step sent this (§16.3 journeys DSL) — the journey IS the signal factory.

window.description: Messaging window context (§16.1). free_ctwa_72h = inside the CTWA-opened free window (§11.2).

cost_minor.description: Metered send cost in INR paise (pre/post BSP+GST per config).
